title: EviACT: An Evidence-to-Action Framework for Agentic Program Repair
abstract: arXiv:2605.27238v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based agents have moved automated program repair (APR) from fixed-context patch generation to interactive repository-level repair. However, existing agentic APR systems still struggle to use execution evidence to guide localization, patch generation, and validation. We propose EviACT (Evidence-to-Action), an agentic APR framework that coordinates three evidence-driven guardrails across repair stages. The retrieval scaffold grounds repair context, the compile gate filters invalid edits, and the test-driven gate checks target-test recovery before full regression. translated_title: EviACT：一个用于智能体程序修复的证据到行动框架
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已将自动化程序修复（APR）从固定上下文的补丁生成推进到交互式的仓库级修复。然而，现有的智能体APR系统在利用执行证据来指导定位、补丁生成和验证方面仍然存在困难。我们提出了EviACT（Evidence-to-Action，证据到行动），一个智能体APR框架，它在修复的各个阶段协调三种由证据驱动的护栏机制：检索支架为修复上下文提供依据，编译门过滤无效的编辑，测试驱动门在全量回归之前检查目标测试的恢复情况。在四个基准测试中，EviACT相比已报告的最强可比基线将解决率提升了1.6-6.0个百分点，并在有基线成本数据的情况下，报告的每缺陷API成本降低了70.1-88.6%。消融实验和诊断分析表明，这些提升与协调一致的证据到行动链条相关，使智能体APR更加高效有效。
tldr: EviACT框架通过检索支架、编译门和测试驱动门三种证据驱动护栏协调修复流程，在四个基准上使智能体程序修复的解决率提升1.6-6.0个百分点，同时将每缺陷API成本降低70.1-88.6%。
en_tdlr: EviACT coordinates three evidence-driven guardrails—a retrieval scaffold, a compile gate, and a test-driven gate—to improve agentic program repair resolve rates by 1.6-6.0 percentage points across four benchmarks while reducing per-bug API costs by 70.1-88.6%.
